about_pullquote: I started this business to give Bolton residents honest, fast heating help at fair prices.
about_para_1: BoilerWizz Bolton was founded on the simple principle that heating emergencies shouldn't mean sky-high call-out charges or long waits. With 15 years' experience across Bolton, we've built a reputation for turning up quickly, diagnosing problems correctly, and fixing them without fuss. We're Gas Safe Registered and fully insured, and we treat every job—whether it's a midnight emergency or a routine service—with the same professionalism.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we listen, explain what's wrong, and give you honest advice about repair versus replacement. We don't use scare tactics or oversell unnecessary work. Whether you're a homeowner with a temperamental boiler or a landlord managing multiple properties, we're here to keep your heating reliable and your costs down.
reviews_heading: What Bolton Homeowners Say About BoilerWizz

reviews.text: Boiler went down on a Sunday afternoon in December. Called BoilerWizz expecting to wait weeks. They came out within an hour, found a broken pump seal, and fitted a new one on the spot. Cost was reasonable and the lad was friendly and professional. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: David M.

reviews.text: Had the boiler serviced every year for the last 3 years now. They always spot something small before it becomes expensive. The engineer is thorough, doesn't rush, and explains everything clearly. Best £150 I spend each year.
reviews.author: Christine T.

reviews.text: New boiler installation from start to finish. They removed the old one, fitted the new combi, handled the gas testing and paperwork. Everything by the book. 10-year warranty on the unit and they even came back to check it was running OK a month later. Very impressed.
reviews.author: Michael K.
